lines.en: Blood in the mire, up ahead.
My stomach echoes, it's so empty.

lines.zh: 沼泽地牢的石头上，我坐着。
lines.en: I sit on the swamp dungeon's stones.

lines.zh: 这片湿地，怎么走都走不完。
lines.en: These wetlands never seem to end.
The gas thickens; someone's ahead.
Who piled rubble in the path?

lines.zh: 地牢的潮气，贴着我的皮。
lines.en: The dungeon's damp clings to my hide.
Who shut this wooden door?

lines.zh: 火把的影子在墙上跟着我。
lines.en: Torch shadows follow along the wall.
The rotted boards give way.
The hall is long; the water drips.
I walk the dungeon's wet mud.

lines.zh: 沼泽地牢里，我一待就是几天。
lines.en: In the swamp dungeon I stay for days.
claws fell off again.
The ceiling drips, and has for hours.

lines.zh: 沼泽地牢里，我数着骨头。
lines.en: In the swamp dungeon, I count bones.
This citrine stone still glows.

lines.zh: 站久了，苔藓爬上了脚背。
lines.en: Standing so long, moss climbs my feet.

lines.zh: 我是不是站错了地牢角落。
lines.en: Have I picked the wrong dungeon corner?

lines.zh: 有只鹤在浅水里盯着我。
lines.en: A crane stares from the shallows.
I wait for the torch to burn out.

lines.zh: 我掉的骨头，都被水泡软了。
lines.en: The bones I drop get soft in the water.

lines.zh: 你身上的铁在沼泽里会烂。
lines.en: Iron rots in this swamp.

lines.zh: 水汽这么重，你还敢下来。
lines.en: So damp down here—and still you came.

lines.zh: 这地牢的路，我自己都记混。
lines.en: Even I lose track of these halls.

lines.zh: 地牢里又来一个举火把的。
lines.en: Another torchbearer in my dungeon.

lines.zh: 苔藓都长到我的肩上了。
lines.en: Moss has grown up to my shoulders.

lines.zh: 你的火把在抖，水汽太重。
lines.en: Your torch flickers in the damp.

lines.zh: 好久没见到会喘气的东西。
lines.en: Long since anything breathed here.

lines.zh: 沼泽地牢里，我一直蹲着。
lines.en: I've been crouching in this swamp dungeon.
Water's behind you; there's no way out.

lines.zh: 沼泽地牢的墙缝里有我。
lines.en: I wait in the cracks of the swamp dungeon.
Mud seals the wound; no more bleeding.

lines.zh: 地牢的砖缝里，我躲惯了。
lines.en: I'm used to hiding in dungeon cracks.
Do not touch me, move back.
A bone cracks; mire seeps in.
Who threw that stone into the mire?
My legs sink in the mire.

lines.zh: 你的味道留在我的黏液上了。
lines.en: Your scent's stuck in my slime now.
You scattered the damp air.

lines.zh: 骨头断了一根，我记住了。
lines.en: One bone snapped; I'll remember.

lines.zh: 地牢的回声把我的叫声放大。
lines.en: The dungeon echoes my cry.

lines.zh: 沼泽的水，泡得我骨头疼。
lines.en: Swamp water aches my bones.

lines.zh: 沼泽的腥气，比吃的更诱人。
lines.en: Swamp stench tempts me more than food.
Hold still; my muddy hands slip.
Is that smell fresh meat?

lines.zh: 沼泽给什么，我就吃什么。
lines.en: Whatever the swamp gives, I eat.

lines.zh: 你比背包里的东西香多了。
lines.en: You smell better than your pack.
Drop it in the mire. Now.

lines.zh: 铁锈味混在泥里，我尝到了。
lines.en: Iron rust in the mud — I taste it.
Toss me what's left in your pack.

lines.zh: 生肉味穿过水汽飘过来。
lines.en: Raw meat cuts through the damp.

lines.zh: 迷宫的墙比沼泽的泥更闷。
lines.en: Maze walls are stuffier than swamp mud.
The mud's slick; steady yourself.

lines.zh: 你踩进泥里，溅了我一身。
lines.en: You stomp the mire and splash me.
That knocked the dungeon wall.
I claimed this dry patch first.

lines.zh: 这走廊只通向更深的泥。
lines.en: This hall leads only to deeper mire.
There are bones in this swamp mud.
Who bumps me in the swamp?

lines.zh: 迷宫的墙，比沼泽的泥更闷。
lines.en: These maze walls are closer than swamp mud.
Step aside. Swamp dungeon corridor.
I bite gently. Try me.

lines.zh: 沼泽地牢的石缝，我钻惯了。
lines.en: I'm used to slipping through the dungeon's cracks.
Growl back at me.
The swamp dungeon walls seep water.
Afraid of the dark? No torches here.

lines.zh: 沼泽地牢里，同伴不动手。
lines.en: In the swamp dungeon, we don't hit kin.
Come back to the mud burrow.
A brood could grow by the drain.
I strung a wet web in the corner.
Let's guard this floor together.
Could this bone be a weapon?
Bury it under the moss.
What falls in the mire belongs to the swamp.

lines.zh: 沼泽地牢的骨头我数得清。
lines.en: I've counted the bones in this dungeon.
A wet stone makes a fine club.

lines.zh: 地牢的湿土里，我捡到它。
lines.en: I found it in the dungeon's wet soil.

lines.zh: 沼泽地牢的骨头，都是我捡的。
lines.en: Every bone in this dungeon, I gathered.
I pick up the bones and count them.
Smells like the swamp dungeon. Edible?
Found it near claws.
You. Don't hide in the mire.

lines.zh: 骨头掉了一地，是我留下的。
lines.en: Bones on the floor — I left them.
Don't shout; echoes draw others.
You crossed the threshold; I was waiting.
The swamp dungeon walls seep water — Blemish, target acquire
The shadow on the wall grows closer.

lines.zh: 地牢的水洼里，我看见你了。
lines.en: In the dungeon puddle, I see you.
The iron smell on you is thick.
The dungeon stones are seeping water.

lines.zh: 地牢的水洼里，我爬出来了。
lines.en: I crawled out of the dungeon puddle.

lines.zh: 后面的门，我用石头堵了。
lines.en: I wedged the far door with stone.
Just you? Even better.

lines.zh: 转过身，让我看清你的背包。
lines.en: Turn around; show me your pack.
From the stone crack, I count you down.
Come out, all of you in the cracks.

lines.zh: 沼泽地牢，只留一个出口。
lines.en: This swamp dungeon keeps a single exit.

lines.zh: 这座沼泽地牢，我比你熟。
lines.en: I know this swamp dungeon better than you.

lines.zh: 跑到地牢尽头也没有门。
lines.en: The dungeon ends with no door.

lines.zh: 沼泽地牢里，我等着脚步。
lines.en: In the swamp dungeon, I listen for steps.
Your steps stop; you hold your breath.
A turn? The drain makes a shortcut.
The torch you dropped went out.

lines.zh: 你的脚步，我在地牢里就听见。
lines.en: I heard your steps inside the dungeon.

lines.zh: 这根骨头，我从泥里捡的。
lines.en: I picked this bone out of the mud.
Slow down; I know these boards.

lines.zh: 地牢的墙角，我数着你的脚步。
lines.en: From this corner I count your steps.

lines.zh: 爬上横梁，我照样够得着。
lines.en: Climb the beams; I can still reach.

lines.zh: 你已经踩进我的泥里了。
lines.en: You have already stepped into my mud.

lines.zh: 沼泽的地牢里，我闻得到你。
lines.en: In the swamp dungeon, I can smell you.
I don't tire; we'll take our time.
A low growl—my prints fill the mud.

lines.zh: 你的同伴在上一层迷路了。
lines.en: Your friends are lost a floor above.

lines.zh: 这地牢的砖缝，正好容我。
lines.en: The gaps between these dungeon bricks fit me.

lines.zh: 沼泽的水都被你搅浑了。
lines.en: You've muddied the swamp water.
Dungeon water is up to my ankles.

lines.zh: 你的靴印在湿泥里很清楚。
lines.en: Your boot prints stand out in the wet mud.

lines.zh: 我烂掉的半边脸，还在笑。
lines.en: My rotted half-face still smiles.

lines.zh: 我从泥里伸出手，抓住你。
lines.en: I reach out of the mire and grab you.

lines.zh: 我从地牢的缝里钻出来。
lines.en: I squeeze out of a dungeon crack.

lines.zh: 我从沼泽地牢的墙上下来。
lines.en: I come down off the swamp dungeon wall.
No one shows mercy down here.
Don't dodge; the boards will give.
Fall into the mire; don't fight it.
Try a fist made of bone.
Mud packs my fist; it hits heavier.

lines.zh: 这面墙挡不住我，你也挡不住。
lines.en: This wall can't stop me, and neither can you.

lines.zh: 沼泽的泥，先糊住你的脚。
lines.en: Swamp mud takes your feet first.
Hold still; one swing ends this.
If it hurts, scream, do not bear it.
My claws are caked in swamp mud.

lines.zh: 低吼一声，你就该倒下了。
lines.en: One growl, and you should drop.
Back into the water and I still swing.

lines.zh: 铁甲在泥里，只会拖住你。
lines.en: Iron armor only drags you down in mire.
The bones drop; pick them up yourself.

lines.zh: 我的骨头，多半是从泥里挖的。
lines.en: Most of my bones were dug from the mud.
Hit. Water sprays across the wall.
First, dry ground to shake off the water.
I've counted every bone here.

lines.zh: 沼泽地牢的墙，一直滴水。
lines.en: The swamp dungeon wall keeps dripping.
Dungeon water is over my feet.

lines.zh: 又是这片湿地牢，湿透了。
lines.en: This wet dungeon again—soaked through.
A low growl rolls down the corridor.

lines.zh: 骨头还在，我又爬回来了。
lines.en: My bones remain; I crawled back.

lines.zh: 我踩过的地方都是黏液。
lines.en: Everything I cross turns slick.
In the dungeon, I woke once more.

lines.zh: 沼泽地牢的门，我从里面出来。
lines.en: I come out from inside the swamp dungeon's door.

lines.zh: 沼泽地牢的墙，我摸熟每一块。
lines.en: I know every brick of this swamp dungeon.

lines.zh: 刚从水里爬出来，腿还软。
lines.en: Just out of the water; my legs are weak.
Fire bakes the mud dry and I ache all over.

lines.zh: 从平台摔下来，砸进泥里。
lines.en: I fell from the ledge into the mire.
Swamp water tastes worse than mud.
After the blast, my ears keep ringing.

lines.zh: 箭头扎进肩胛，拔不出来。
lines.en: An arrow's stuck in my shoulder blade.

lines.zh: 魔法烧过的地方，骨头都露了。
lines.en: Where the magic burned, my bones show.
Nothing to eat in the dungeon; I am starving.
The ceiling leaks; lightning got in.

lines.zh: 虚空的泥，连骨头都化了。
lines.en: Void mud dissolves even bone.
